detail: Code asserts pathname /user/account, but frames 05-07 show the My account page with the user menu still open and no 'Now on <url>' caption; the video never shows the URL reached by clicking the link. Show the URL caption after the highlight (and move the pointer off the menu) so a frame shows it.

Code asserts /user/orders and document.title 'My orders | AdventureWorks', but frames 05-07 show only the My orders heading and empty state with the menu open; neither the URL nor the tab title caption appears in any frame. Show the caption after the highlight so a frame shows both values.

The case's expected result is URL path /user/account. The test asserts it, but keyframes 05-07 show the account page with no caption naming the URL; the demo.caption('Now on …') call does not appear in any frame, so the recording does not show where the click landed (lesson L2). Make the URL caption persist into the highlight frame, e.g. put it in the highlight label after the caption has rendered.

The case expects URL path /user/orders and tab title 'My orders | AdventureWorks'. Keyframes 05-08 show the My orders page, but none shows the 'Now on …/user/orders' caption or the 'document.title = …' caption, so neither expected result appears in the video (lesson L2).

showAddressBar centres a white-space:pre banner with translateX(-50%); on the long Identity /Account/Login?ReturnUrl=... URL it overflows both viewport edges, so the 'URL:' prefix and the identity origin are cut off in the highlight frame. The redirect target is readable only in the unstyled demo caption at the top-left. The banner should wrap or show only origin+pathname.

Same clipped address-bar banner on the Identity login page after logout; the URL origin in the banner is off-screen and only the small top-left caption shows '/user/account -> http://host.docker.internal:30081/Account/Login'.
